text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon and I have just started
our
training, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... It appears that system functions are impaired.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Damage to body, not detected.
Probable
cause—mild exhaustion from
racing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
These issues are minor and will not
impact our
schedule today. I can
continue running as
planned.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I have failed to execute
your
orders. I sincerely apologize.
choice_data_list: 無理せず、今日はあがろう
choice_data_list_en: Let's not overdo it. We'll call it a day.

text_block_list.text:
She tends to push herself too hard, even
when
she's tired. It might be best to
readjust her race
schedule.
